_instructions: Copy this file (e.g. to config.json), fill in your own values, and point Jenny at the copy. Never edit this template directly.

brand._instructions: Your own brand system. If you're also running a plugin with its own brand guidelines file (same schema), point brand_source_path at your filled-in copy instead of re-entering everything below. Otherwise fill in the summary fields directly.
brand.brand_source_path: [PATH TO YOUR OWN BRAND GUIDELINES OR DESIGN TOKENS FILE, IF YOU HAVE ONE]

surfaces._instructions: One entry per recurring asset or output type you produce. Add as many as you need.

web._instructions: Only needed if you're using web-spec-handoff or web-consistency-audit.
web.style_guide_path: [PATH TO YOUR SITE'S STYLE GUIDE / DESIGN SYSTEM FILE]

notifications._instructions: Where Jenny reports deliveries, findings, and approval requests.
notifications.webhook_url_env: [NAME OF YOUR ENV VAR -- never paste the URL itself here]

authority._instructions: Adjust to your own risk tolerance -- see core/capabilities.md for the suggested split.
authority.rule_based_web_fixes: [e.g. 'open a PR to staging, human merges']
authority.template_promotion: [e.g. 'propose, wait for my confirmation before marking active']
authority.design_system_changes: [e.g. 'propose only, I approve before anything commits']
